notes: SHIP v1.14.409 - THE FORGE BOTTOM DOCK BECOMES ONE DOCK OF TWO ROWS. Owner brief, owner-approved on the 390px mockups before stamping. ROW 1 is selection and action: the scrollable rack chips on the left, the loadout and search buttons on the right, all three consumers sharing one 44px height and one baseline. ROW 2 is context: the single wide .herotag card is retired for three compact .statpill read-outs - the focused rack id, the rack state, and the walk instruction. NOTHING NEW IS COMPUTED. deploy_forge_tagSub already concatenated exactly those three clauses into one string with two separators; each pill now owns one clause it was already rendering. The function is renamed deploy_forge_tagState and NARROWED rather than reused, deliberately: a same-named function returning a different shape is the trap that produced the v1.14.348 arity bug, and both call sites had to be visited anyway. TWO CLAUSES LEFT THE STRING AND ONE STAYED, each for a stated reason. The site label is gone: it is already the first term of #forge3d-prov in the sheet header, and carrying it twice is the same redundancy .407 deleted a fourth copy of. TAP FLANKS TO WALK becomes static markup in #tagWalk, shipped hidden, because before a rack is focused there is no aisle to walk - setFocus reveals it and the zero state hides it again. The flag count STAYS GLUED to the count pill instead of becoming a fourth pill, because it is conditional and a fourth pill does not fit 390px; it is expressed as a gold .flagged state on the count. GOLD, NEVER RED - it is the attention channel, and 0/0 RACKED IS NOT AN ERROR: a cable-endpoint-only cabinet honestly resolves with zero hosts, and reading that as a fault nearly rolled production back once. ONE WRITER PER STATUS SHAPE. writeStatusPills and writeStatusMessage are declared immediately under the elements they write, so no caller can put a concatenated string into a slot that owns a single clause - and declared ABOVE first use, because this IIFE is ~1000 lines and has already shipped a bug where a var declared below its first use silently wiped an earlier assignment, which node --check cannot see. THE FIRST IMPLEMENTATION SHIPPED TWO REGRESSIONS AND THE SCREENSHOT FOUND BOTH, neither of which was visible in the CSS. In the zero state the identical 59-character sentence rendered TWICE, stacked about 20px apart in two type treatments, because deploy_forge_zeroState wrote it into #hint AND the status row; the .407 comment in that very function had already named this redundancy when it deleted the fourth copy, and decomposing the card put the surviving two directly on top of each other. The division of labour is now explicit and commented: the hint is the INSTRUCTION surface, the status row is the STATE surface. And with no rack focused the id pill rendered a bare bullet and an em dash - a dot, a dash and no information - so it is hidden in a message state and revealed symmetrically the moment there is an id worth showing. MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED, on WebKit at 390x844 and 834x1194. The dock is 110px populated against a 142-160px baseline and 124px in the zero state; the three pills land on ONE row at 18..95, 101..195 and 201..356 inside an 18..372 field; every chip and button measures at or above the 44px floor in BOTH the populated and the empty state; horizontal overflow is 0 in every state; and the derived 10px clearance from .408 still holds exactly across a focus stack forced from 110 to 304px. Zero-state message copies inside the dock: 1. GATES: 3 inline blocks compile, node --check sw.js, valid JSON, CSS braces balanced, CRLF intact with 0 lone LF, PRECACHE untouched, three-stamp lockstep. The .408 lever is re-asserted and still true - .hud remains position:absolute with no z-index, so the toast still beats the open detail panel and UNDO survives. RACK SCENE LOCK respected: nothing under #forge3d-mount, forge3d_render, drawGuts or the camera rig; this is the HUD layer outside the scene. ?legacy=1 unaffected - every selector is scoped to #forge3d-sheet, which is body.rd gated. The pills carry NO handler, role, tabindex or cursor: they are read-outs, not buttons that do nothing. GUARD: test/e2e/08-forge-layout.spec.js grows to 26 tests. Because two dock members are now CONDITIONAL and the harness sits in the zero state, three existing tests were repaired by populating the dock first - so a new test pins the conditional behaviour directly and asserts the zero-state message appears EXACTLY ONCE with no empty id pill, which is what stops the populate helper from masking that regression class again. 25 passed, 1 device-only skip. THREE ITEMS WERE FLAGGED TO THE OWNER RATHER THAN SILENTLY FIXED, and none is introduced by this ship: the caption still wraps to two lines at 390 orphaning '3D', which is pre-existing copy length; the zero-state row 1 is right-weighted because there are no chips without a Master; and chips 4 and 5 sit off-screen at a full five-rack loadout with nothing signalling that the strip scrolls, which is the carried .407 ruling. DEVICE-VERIFY, folded into the open batch pass: clear the service-worker cache, confirm v1.14.409, open the aisle with NO Master and confirm the dock says its sentence once with no bare dot-and-dash pill; load a Master, focus a rack and confirm the three pills read id, count and walk on ONE row with no clipping; focus a flagged rack and confirm the count pill goes GOLD, not red; and confirm the strip still clears the home indicator, which env(safe-area-inset-bottom) resolving to 0 in the harness means is verified by NOTHING off-device.
